method: Manually trace the six explicit room labels and principal walls on actual rendered source pages. Register each scanned drawing with an orientation-preserving similarity fit to matching expansion-wing walls in the existing Facilities geometry; separately check withheld wall corners. The fifth floor uses repeated exterior corners on Level 4. Retain all original geometry. Append only the old-wing floor-plate portion outside the existing expansion-wing join edge. Other old-wing rooms, bridges and external stairs remain unmodeled.

limitations: The 2026 emergency-action-plan packet embeds older scanned diagrams. Inclusion in the packet does not establish that every room boundary was resurveyed in 2026.

Registration inherits the existing approximate Facilities-to-campus fit. Scan distortion, simplified walls and old/new-wing correspondence limit positional accuracy; control and holdout residuals are drawing consistency checks, not survey accuracy.
Only the six previously unresolved schedule rooms are traced. Small door and column recesses are simplified; room use is left unknown.
The added old-wing floor plates are simplified main-body envelopes following the visible room/corridor bounds. Bridges, external stairs, balconies and other old-wing rooms are not reconstructed.

Existing room geometry, all five floors, estimated elevations and campus transform are preserved. Level 5 retains the pre-existing Level 4-derived expansion-wing outline; that part is not newly verified.
